dashboard_line: 23 CI/CD scripts discovered; 5 critical issues: missing staging gate, B2 rate limits (40% failures), hardcoded credentials, silent nightly failures, no approval gates
prescan_decision: passed — no recent CI/CD consolidation work found

artifacts.description: 23-row inventory of all discovered CI/CD scripts; categorized by function (A-E); status (RED/YELLOW/GREEN); critical issues per script
ASCII pipeline flows (5 tracks); bottleneck analysis; consolidation recommendation

issue_1_staging_gate_missing.description: No staging environment gate; changes deploy directly from dev to prod
issue_1_staging_gate_missing.impact: Breaking changes can reach production without review

issue_2_b2_rate_limit_bottleneck.description: B2 API returns HTTP 429; scripts have hard-coded 60s timeout with no retry/backoff; ~40% failure rate
issue_2_b2_rate_limit_bottleneck.impact: Manifests not uploaded (audit trail incomplete); backups incomplete (recovery impossible); monitoring blind spot
issue_2_b2_rate_limit_bottleneck.root_cause: No exponential backoff; no circuit breaker; hard-coded timeout

issue_3_hardcoded_credentials.description: B2 auth credentials in ~/.env.local (plaintext); scripts source from file instead of CI/CD secrets
issue_3_hardcoded_credentials.risk: Keys can be committed to git; exposed in CI logs; vulnerable to accidental leaks
issue_3_hardcoded_credentials.fix_effort: low (1-2 hours to wire GitLab CI Variables; --masked --protected)

issue_4_silent_failures_nightly.description: GitLab CI stages with allow_failure=true: coc-verify, coc-nightly-backup, coc-nightly-monitor; pipeline passes even if critical checks fail
issue_4_silent_failures_nightly.impact: Corruption/missing backups not detected until recovery attempt; health blind spot
issue_4_silent_failures_nightly.fix_effort: low (flip allow_failure to false; add pre-backup validation)

issue_5_no_approval_gate_bucket_creation.description: coc-create-bucket (manual web trigger) executes immediately with no policy review; no legal-hold validation
issue_5_no_approval_gate_bucket_creation.risk: Accidental/malicious bucket creation; retention policy not enforced; WORM lock mode not validated
issue_5_no_approval_gate_bucket_creation.fix_effort: medium (add approval stage + policy check before creation)

issue_6_forensics_sync_nightly_only.description: Forensics synced to WORM only at nightly cron; 24h delay from task completion to WORM write
issue_6_forensics_sync_nightly_only.impact: Audit trail incomplete during 24h window; task failure not recorded in WORM immediately
issue_6_forensics_sync_nightly_only.fix_effort: low (add on-demand sync trigger in agent post-task hook)

issue_7_manifest_signature_bypassable.description: --skip-sig-check flag allows bypassing signature verification in forensics sync
issue_7_manifest_signature_bypassable.risk: Unsigned/corrupted manifests can be synced to WORM
issue_7_manifest_signature_bypassable.fix_effort: low (remove bypass flag; fail on signature mismatch)

issue_8_no_rollback_procedure.description: No blue-green deployment; no instant rollback to previous version
issue_8_no_rollback_procedure.impact: Broken deployments can't be quickly reverted

moderate_issues.description: No automated retry on network failures (backup/monitor scripts timeout silently)
Bucket compliance audit (4x_bucket_compliance_audit.py) not automated to alerting

friction_analysis.primary_bottleneck: B2 API rate limiting (40% failure rate on backup/monitor)
secondary_bottlenecks: Scattered scripts across 3 repos (no unified orchestrator)

migration_path: Week 2: Migrate hustle/ CI/CD to call unified pipeline
Week 3: Migrate faerie2/ forensics sync to use unified backup stage
Week 4: Decommission scattered scripts; consolidate to single source

metadata.discovery_method: Recursive grep across 3 repos; script content analysis; flow mapping
